subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “this subject was turned into a children's safety museum.”?
options: A retired firefighter told them that courage was important, but preparation saved more lives.
The retired teacher says the red door is important because it tells children one thing before they even enter: stories are waiting for you.
Safety lights remained at important corners, but bright lights near the water were reduced.
Some parts were sad, but much of the museum focused on preparation and rebuilding.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A retired firefighter told them that courage was important, but preparation saved more lives.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The retired teacher says the red door is important because it tells children one thing before they even…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Safety lights remained at important corners, but bright lights near the water were reduced.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some parts were sad, but much of the museum focused on preparation and rebuilding.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A retired firefighter told them that courage was important, but preparation saved more lives.」，答案為「A retired firefighter told them that courage was important, but preparation saved more lives.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A retired firefighter told them that courage was important, but preparation saved more lives.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
